create_task_resolve_storage_uri: create a REST endpoint that resolves storage URIs for tasks and returns presigned URLs or proxied data
create_project_resolve_storage_uri: create a REST endpoint that resolves storage URIs for projects and returns presigned URLs or proxied data
resolve_storage_uri: resolve a base64-encoded storage URI to either a presigned URL redirect or a data proxy stream
proxy_data_from_storage: proxy file data from a cloud storage backend through Label Studio with range requests and time-limited streaming
redirect_to_presign_url: generate and redirect to a presigned URL for a storage URI with cache control and CORS header cleanup
